items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: I even collaborated in the production of a Duke Ellington concert one time with Rhys Dupree

ctx.x: And I was always prepared to discuss. I mean, I even collaborated in the production of a Duke Ellington concert one time with Rhys Dupree, who was the composer of Shorten and Bread, was the co-producer who talked me into it, and who also was the one who introduced me to Jelly Roll Morton. Mm-hmm.
Was it the year that the Goodman band?
